From: GovConnect Procurement <procurement@govconnect.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GovConnect supplier onboarding form and PO requirements

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick response on the MSA. To get vendor setup started in our procurement system (Coupa) we need the following items from your side:

- Completed supplier registration PDF (attached).
- Legal entity name, W-9/W-8 (or VAT ID for non-US entities).
- DUNS number (if available) and remit-to banking details for ACH.
- Signed (or countersigned via DocuSign) MSA + order form.
- A single point-of-contact for invoicing and PO reconciliation (name + email + phone).

Coupa specifics:
- PO numbers will be prefixed with GOV- by default; invoices must reference the PO number.
- We can accept custom vendor fields (e.g., GL codes), but require the mappings during onboarding.
- For larger suppliers we also request a sample invoice to validate parsing.

Attached is our supplier registration PDF. Can you confirm estimated time to complete registration and whether your legal team will be able to review the redlines we received?

Best,
Maya Dawson
Vendor Onboarding Lead
GovConnect Procurement
procurement@govconnect.com

Subject: Re: GovConnect supplier onboarding form and PO requirements

Hi Maya — thanks for the checklist and the form.

We completed the supplier form draft and attached a tracked-redline MSA (MSA_redline_v3.docx) with a few items we need clarification on before we sign:

1) Indemnity / third-party claims: we proposed a more limited indemnity tied to breach and will need to confirm acceptable language for open-source components.
2) Liability cap: we asked to align the cap to fees under the order form rather than a fixed dollar figure; please confirm if your finance team requires a specific numeric cap.
3) Data residency & audit: our legal team requires clarity on audit windows and whether logs will be retained by GovConnect for 7+ years — is that negotiable?

Operational questions for Coupa onboarding:
- Can you confirm the exact vendor field keys for: remit_to, tax_id, vendor_code, and preferred_invoice_email? We want to avoid mismatches that block PO transmission.
- Do you accept CSV bulk uploads for initial vendor creation or only manual entry?
- For GL mapping: does Coupa accept multiline GL allocations per invoice line or only one GL per invoice?

Commercial / billing items for your sales team:
- Billing cadence: we typically bill monthly in arrears. Is Net 45 acceptable or do you require Net 30?
- For the initial order form: will you require a minimum committed spend or forecast?

Attached: MSA_redline_v3.docx (Word document, tracked changes)

If helpful, Ben and Dev are cc'd to address commercial/contract logistics. Would GovConnect legal be available for a short call this week to go through redlines?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding GovConnect's checklist and Soojin's reply. Quick internal summary / recommended positions before we jump on a call:

- Indemnity: we should offer a middle ground (limited to breach of confidentiality and IP infringement tied to our indemnity insurance). Do not accept open-ended indemnity for third-party claims.
- Liability cap: propose 12 months of average fees under the initial order form (we can calculate after Ben confirms pricing).
- Data retention: ask for a scoped audit window (e.g., logs for 2 years) and push back on 7+ years unless govt regulation requires it.

Operational notes:
- Coupa mappings: ask procurement for exact JSON/CSV sample they use for bulk vendor upload; this avoids repeated back-and-forth.
- PO requirements: require that all invoices include the GOV-PO number and vendor remit instructions on the first page to satisfy AP parsing.

I've attached an example order form template (orderform_example.xlsx) with the commercial fields we expect them to populate (billing cadence, tax jurisdiction, PO acceptance language). Ben — can you confirm the proposed commercial terms and the initial billing cadence we want to push?

Thanks,

Hi Soojin — thanks for the detailed note and the redlines. Responding to your questions below and attaching the DocuSign envelope for counter-signature: https://www.docusign.com/drive/embedded?envelopeId=1234-ABCD

Redlines / legal:
- Indemnity: GovConnect can accept a limited indemnity tied to direct breach and IP claims; broader third-party indemnities are not acceptable. Your proposed language narrowing scope looks reasonable — send the tracked text and we'll try to accommodate.
- Liability cap: Our finance team prefers a numeric cap. Can you provide a suggested cap tied to 12 months of expected fees? We can review and give a yes/no quickly.
- Data retention / audits: Our standard is logs retained for 3 years; for special records we can accommodate up to 5 years with advance notice.

Coupa / onboarding logistics: 
- We support CSV bulk upload for initial vendor creation; please provide the CSV sample using the fields: vendor_code, legal_name, remit_to, tax_id, remit_email, preferred_invoice_email, default_gl_code. We attached the sample mapping in the GovConnect_Supplier_Form.pdf.
- GL mapping: Coupa supports up to 3 GL splits per invoice line via our custom field; please confirm how Redwood will send split allocations.
- PO/invoice processing: All invoices must include the GOV-PO prefix; AP will reject invoices missing the PO number.

Next steps / timeline:
1) Please upload the completed supplier CSV and the signed MSA via DocuSign link above.
2) Once we receive the signed MSA + supplier CSV, onboarding is typically 3–5 business days.
3) We will provision remittance and provide a vendor ID (GC-xxxxx) and Coupa access.

Attachments: DocuSign counter-sign link (DocuSign envelope: 1234-ABCD).

Best regards,
Alicia Mendoza
Senior Counsel, Contracts
GovConnect
